INDUSTRIAL DISPUTE.

Some 400 employees of the Yee Zoong Dao Chinese
Medicine Shop, Head Office 101 Avenue Road, with thirteen
branches situated in the Settlement and French Concession,
declared a strike on September 24th, 1940 in order to enforce
demands for better treatment and an increase in wages and rice
allowance.

On September 29th, the proprietor of the Medicine
Shop received a threatening letter purporting to have come from
the "Special Movement Executive Committee", in which he was
warned to meet the workers' demands within three days otherwise
drastic action would be taken against him.

On October 7th, two representatives of the employees,
namely Wu Tong (吳棟) and Chang Ngo Tsu (張鶴初), called in
the office of the Industrial Section and submitted a petition
requesting mediation.

A meeting was held at the office of the Industrial
Section at 10 a.m. October 9th. Messrs. Chang Peo Shih (張寶鈞)
and Ching Tsong Chiso (岑宗嶠) represented the Management, and
Wu Tong and Chang Ngo Tsu attended on behalf of the employees.
The demands submitted by the employees were:-

1) The Management shall recognise the Labour
Union's right to represent all the employees.

2) The Management shall not dismiss employees
without just cause.

3) A minimum wage of $20 per month shall be
paid to employees, and a minimum of $16 per
month to coolies.

4) A rice allowance of $15 per month shall be
granted to all employees, and half this
amount when the price of rice falls below
$30 per picul

5) A monthly allowance of $6 per month shall
be granted to all employees and apprentices.

6) Treatment regarding hours of work, holidays,
bonuses, etc. shall be meted out in accord-
ance with the old Collective Agreement of
the trade.

9月29日，该药店店主收到一封恐吓信，声称来自“特种运动执行委员会”，信中警告他必须在三天内满足工人要求，否则将对他采取严厉行动。

10月7日，两名雇员代表，即 Wu Tong（吳棟）和 Chang Ngo Tsu（張鶴初），前往工业科办公室，提交请愿书请求调解。

10月9日上午10时，在工业科办公室举行会议。Chang Peo Shih（張寶鈞）先生和 Ching Tsong Chiso（岑宗嶠）先生代表资方，Wu Tong 和 Chang Ngo Tsu 代表劳方出席。雇员提出的要求如下：

1) 资方应承认工会代表所有雇员的权利。

2) 资方不得无故解雇雇员。

3) 雇员最低工资应为每月20美元，苦力最低工资为每月16美元。

4) 所有雇员应获得每月15美元的米贴，当米价低于每担30美元时，此金额减半。

5) 所有雇员和学徒应获得每月6美元的津贴。

6) 关于工作时间、假期、奖金等待遇，应按照该行业旧的集体协议执行。
